Wardrobes / Praha · Smíchov

Smíchov Wardrobe

Made-to-measure storage that belongs to the room.

The approach

A quieter room begins with a place for everything.

A wardrobe should work with the architecture rather than feel like an addition. The design considers the room’s proportions, door clearances and the way storage is used each day.

Inside, hanging space, shelving and drawers can be arranged around personal routines. Fronts, handles and finishes are selected as one coherent composition.
